entries.reason: #1079, rule 2, the timing gap on a slot: a parallel slot's loader boundary reads the loader aggregate itself (slots get no per-loader streams, src/segment-system.tsx:772-803; LoaderResolver's use(loaderDataPromise), src/route-content-wrapper.tsx:334). getMemoizedLoaderPromise hands the aggregate as a promise when the tree is built while it is pending (src/segment-loader-promise.ts:134); when it settles before React renders the slot, React suspends on a settled promise and the @badge slot mounts its loading() fallback. Seen once in a full dev run at load 20-49; 0 of 6 reruns, and 0 of 6 with 8x CPU throttling. Timing-dependent.

entries.test: navigation.test.ts > stale-revalidation > should update quantity on intercept after action on detail page and back navigation
entries.reason: Undeclared, cause: an action started on the intercepted /product/product-a completes after a navigation to the same URL without the intercept (View full details). The action bridge reconciles the response's matched ids, computed for the intercept page (the home route M0L0L0R0 and its ProductsLoader under the modal), against the detail page's cache (src/browser/server-action-bridge.ts:709, segment-reconciler.ts:184) before classifyActionOutcome (server-action-bridge.ts:726) sees the history key change and discards the result; pathname checks cannot tell the two pages apart. Reproduced on origin/main.
